responsibility: This file implements the -fdump-go-spec support that emits Go declarations corresponding to selected C declarations and macros. By wrapping GCC's debug hooks, it captures functions, typedefs, variables, and preprocessor macro values from compiled headers, formats them as hidden Go definitions for use by the Go runtime support library, tracks valid and invalid type names, and synthesizes dummy types where needed. It is a build-time bridge from GCC's C front-end/debug metadata to Go runtime interface descriptions.
